wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws = wb["Sheet1"]

# Compute the average of B1:B10
b_values = [
    ws[f"B{row}"].value
    for row in range(1, 11)
    if isinstance(ws[f"B{row}"].value, (int, float))
]
avg_b = sum(b_values) / len(b_values)

# Find the first row where cumulative sum of A values meets/exceeds avg_b
cumulative_sum = 0
highlight_until = None

for row in range(1, 11):
    value = ws[f"A{row}"].value
    if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
        cumulative_sum += value
        if cumulative_sum >= avg_b:
            highlight_until = row
            break

# Highlight A1 through the satisfying row in yellow
yellow_fill = PatternFill(fill_type="solid", fgColor="FFFF00")

if highlight_until is not None:
    for row in range(1, highlight_until + 1):
        ws[f"A{row}"].fill = yellow_fill
